abstract: With initial orchiectomy and radiation therapy, the prognosis of the patients with early (Stages I and II-A) testicular seminoma is nearing almost 100 percent. Thirty-two patients with Stage I and 13 patients with Stage II-A seminoma of the testis were treated with initial orchiectomy. This was followed by estimation biochemical markers and radiologic investigations. All the patients with Stage I disease received radiotherapy to the ipsilateral pelvic and para-aortic nodes. The patients with Stage II-A disease also received radiation therapy to the supradiaphragmatic regions. The disease-free survival in both groups of patients was found to be 100 percent.
abstract_ja: 初回の精巣摘除術と放射線療法により、早期(病期Iおよび病期II-A)の精巣セミノーマ患者の予後はほぼ100%に近づいている。病期Iのセミノーマ患者32例と病期II-Aのセミノーマ患者13例の精巣を、初回精巣摘除術により治療した。その後、生化学的マーカーの推定と放射線学的検査を行った。病期Iのすべての患者は、同側の骨盤リンパ節および傍大動脈リンパ節への放射線療法を受けた。病期II-Aの患者は、横隔膜上領域への放射線療法も受けた。両群の無病生存率は100%であった。
